The '''Hamner Heavy Ores Plant''' was an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] installation over [[Rett II]] in the [[Rettna system/Legends|Rettna system]]. It was [[Battle of the Rettna system|destroyed]] by forces of the [[Freda system militias]].
